name: cohors
description: The state of every git repository you own, and what to do next, in one editor tab. Needs the cohors command-line tool.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace cohors still shows your repositories, but agents, tasks and flows declared by a repository are disabled and the workspace cannot set which folders are scanned.

viewsWelcome.contents:
The cohors command-line tool was not found. Install it, or point the cohors.binaryPath setting at it.
[How to install](command:cohors.installHelp)
[Open settings](command:cohors.openSettings)

[Open dashboard](command:cohors.show)

No repositories were found under your roots.
[Use this workspace's folders](command:cohors.useWorkspaceRoots)
[Open settings](command:cohors.openSettings)

cohors.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `cohors` command-line tool. Leave empty to find `cohors` on your login shell's `PATH`.

cohors.roots.markdownDescription: Folders to scan for repositories. Leave empty to use the roots in your cohors config file. The command **cohors: Use this workspace's folders as roots** fills this in for the current workspace.

cohors.refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between background refreshes. It only ticks while the dashboard tab is focused, and file changes in the open workspace refresh it straight away. 0 turns polling off.
